violated_contract: A release mutation or qualification process must have a finite execution deadline and retain ownership of launcher descendants until termination; a hung subprocess must become an unknown journal outcome rather than leave the transaction in flight forever.
canonical_prevention: Give each process owner a fixed deadline, isolate its POSIX process group, terminate the group on completion or timeout, and preserve null-exit reconciliation without mutation retries. Exercise actual hanging parent/child processes and reject valid-looking evidence from a process that never exited successfully. The 2026-09-04 CF5 review found unbounded spawnSync owners in both Wrangler mutations and release qualifiers; the local Wrangler version-check connection also delayed completion beyond its printed dry-run result.
